functions.name: generate_clip_assets
functions.title: Generate AI clip assets
functions.description: Analyzes a video owned by the signed-in creator and returns 8 short-clip concepts with timestamp ranges and hooks, 10 SEO title variants, 5 thumbnail concepts, auto-generated chapters, and a 200-word SEO description. Call when a creator wants repurposing assets for one of their videos.

videoId.description: The id of the Video record to analyze. The signed-in user must own the video.

functions.name: calculate_creator_reputation
functions.title: Calculate creator reputation
functions.description: Computes a 0-100 reputation score for a channel from upload consistency, watch time, engagement, growth, strikes and reports, assigns a level (bronze/silver/gold/platinum), checks monetization and featured eligibility, and upserts a CreatorReputation record. Pass channelId to score a specific channel; omit to score the signed-in user's own channel.

channelId.description: Optional Channel id to score. Omit to use the signed-in user's own channel.

functions.name: recommend_videos
functions.title: Recommend videos
functions.description: Returns a personalized feed of up to 50 public videos for the signed-in user using a 3-layer engine (popularity, personalization from watch history and subscriptions, exploration). Optionally filter by a single category. Call when a user wants a recommended video list.

limit.description: Maximum videos to return, 1-50. Defaults to 30.

category.description: Optional category filter (case-insensitive). Use 'All' or omit for no filter.

functions.name: cloud_browser_control
functions.title: Cloud browser control
functions.description: Controls the Xtreme Cloud Browser engine for on-demand web automation with stealth, CAPTCHA solving, and anti-bot bypass. Actions: 'navigate' (go to a URL), 'observe' (read visible text + URL + title), 'extract' (pull text/html/attribute/table/json from a CSS selector), 'screenshot' (capture page), 'execute' (run a raw engine action like click/fill/press/wait/crawl), 'health' (check engine status). Each call spins up a fresh isolated browser session and cleans up after. Use for scraping, skip tracing, competitor research, and data extraction from JS-heavy or bot-protected pages.

action.description: Browser action to perform. 'navigate' goes to a URL, 'observe' reads page text, 'extract' pulls structured data from a selector, 'screenshot' captures the page, 'execute' runs a raw engine action, 'health' checks engine status.

engine_action.description: Raw engine action_type for 'execute' (e.g. click, fill, press, wait, crawl).

value.description: Value for 'execute' action (e.g. text to fill, key to press).

options.description: Additional engine options for 'execute' or 'navigate' (wait_until, timeout, etc).

max_chars.description: Max characters for 'observe' action. Defaults to 20000.

functions.name: cloud_browser_skip_trace
functions.title: Cloud browser skip trace
functions.description: Uses the stealth cloud browser to discover trending videos across YouTube (bypassing anti-bot measures), classifies them into 10 distinct viral style templates via AI, and upserts them into the ViralTemplate library. Call when you want to refresh the viral template collection with the latest trending patterns.

refresh.description: If true, forces a full re-scan. If false or omitted, still runs discovery.
